usedFor: Timeero tracks mileage and GPS time, and “Job Created” there can start “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive.

bestTemplate.name: “User Created” in Timeero, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: When a user is created, a file can be made available by link at Viewer, Commenter or Editor level.

watchOut: “User Updated” and “Group Updated” fire on every change, so “Share File With Anyone” can run repeatedly.
